summaryZh: OptiLab 研究基于大脑与技术的方法，以加快学习和促进恢复。方法包括心理测量、EEG、fMRI、TMS、tDCS 及神经可塑性药物辅助治疗。

evidence.quote: Home Research Overview Participate Publications Research in Action People Our Team Collaborators & Funding Jobs and Opportunities News and Happenings Contact Us Human Performance Optimization Laboratory The Human Performance Optimization Laboratory (OptiLab) is an applied cognitive neuroscience lab, led by ﻿​ Dr. Greg Appelbaum ﻿ that researches brain-based and technology-enabled approaches to accelerate learning and speed recovery. We conduct a wide variety of applied science that uses psychometrics to capture behavior, brain measurements done with EEG and fMRI, brain stimulation done with TMS and tDCS, and neuroplastogen-assisted therapies using psilocybin and ketamine. We strive to transcend scientific, clinical, and professional domains to investigate useful approaches to optimize learning, improve diagnostics, and create better therapeutics. OptiLab is part of the UCSD Department of Psychiatry , the UCSD Neuroscience Graduate Program , and the SDSU/UCSD Joint Doctoral Program in Clinical Psychology . From our home base in Guava Hall at the University of California, San Diego we enjoy many productive collaborations with groups including the Interventional Psychiatry Program , the Center for the Future of Surgery , the Wu Tsai Human Performance Alliance , UCSD Athletics , and the ARPA-H EVIDENT program. We greatly enjoy transdisciplinary science that adheres to rigorous measurement principles, and we even get to dabble in some pretty cool projects like studying flow states in musicians . Please follow the links for information about our science, our team, or for opportunities to participate in our studies. Also be sure to check out the " Research In Action " page for photos of the team at work (and play).
